sim=require'sim'

require 'configUi'

sim.setBufferProperty(sim.getObject('..'), 'customData.__schema__',sim.packTable{
    xSize={
        default=5,
        maximum=200,
        minimum=1,
        name="X size",
        type="float",
        ui={
            control="spinbox",
            order=10,col=1
        },
    },
    ySize={
        default=5,
        maximum=200,
        minimum=1,
        name="Y size",
        type="float",
        ui={
            control="spinbox",
            order=20,col=1
        },
    },
    thickness={
        default=0.2,
        maximum=1,
        minimum=0.05,
        name="Thickness",
        type="float",
        ui={
            control="spinbox",
            order=30,col=2
        },
    },
    height={
        default=0.5,
        maximum=5,
        minimum=0.01,
        name="Height",
        type="float",
        ui={
            control="spinbox",
            order=40,col=2
        },
    },
    color={
        type='color',
        name='Color',
        default={1,1,1},
        ui={order=50,col=1,},
    },
})

configUi=ConfigUI('ExternalWall',nil,function(config)
    local self=sim.getObject('..')
    
    local children=sim.getObjectsInTree(self,sim.sceneobject_shape,1)
    sim.removeObjects(children)
    
    local p=sim.createPrimitiveShape(sim.primitiveshape_cuboid,{config.xSize+config.thickness*2,config.thickness,config.height})
    sim.setObjectColor(p,0,sim.colorcomponent_ambient_diffuse,config.color)
    sim.setObjectPosition(p,{0,-config.ySize*0.5-config.thickness*0.5,config.height*0.5})
    local all={p}
    p=sim.copyPasteObjects({p},0)[1]
    sim.setObjectPosition(p,{0,config.ySize*0.5+config.thickness*0.5,config.height*0.5})
    all[2]=p
    p=sim.createPrimitiveShape(sim.primitiveshape_cuboid,{config.thickness,config.ySize+config.thickness*2,config.height})
    sim.setObjectColor(p,0,sim.colorcomponent_ambient_diffuse,config.color)
    sim.setObjectPosition(p,{-config.xSize*0.5-config.thickness*0.5,0,config.height*0.5})
    all[3]=p
    p=sim.copyPasteObjects({p},0)[1]
    sim.setObjectPosition(p,{config.xSize*0.5+config.thickness*0.5,0,config.height*0.5})
    all[4]=p
    p=sim.groupShapes(all)
    sim.setObjectParent(p,self,true)
    local prop=sim.getObjectProperty(p)
    sim.setObjectProperty(p,(prop|sim.objectproperty_selectable|sim.objectproperty_ignoreviewfitting)-sim.objectproperty_selectable)
    sim.setBoolProperty(p, 'respondable', true)
end)

configUi.getObjectCallback = function() return sim.getObject '..' end
